data.title: Speed round: hide the password before logging
story: Write a function redact(data) that takes a dictionary (dict) and returns a NEW dictionary. If there is a "password" key, its value becomes "***". Other keys are copied as they are.
A hidden test makes sure the original dictionary does not change!

tests.name: original untouched
tests.code: d = {"password": "secret"}; s = redact(d); assert d["password"] == "secret" and s["password"] == "***"

explanation: Make a new dictionary, copy every key, and replace the "password" value with "***". That way the log stays safe, while the original data can still be used to log in.
hints: Start with result = {}, then loop over every key with for key in data.
Inside the loop: if key == "password", store "***". Otherwise copy data[key].
